limitations.note: The actual fix was to decode the outputs combinationally from the current state and selection, but the rewrite kept them registered and changed coin acceptance and change dispensing instead.
The testbench mirrored the rewrite’s credit and clocking rules, so even 20,000 randomized cycles did not check whether dispensing asserted as soon as the FSM entered a dispensing state.

limitations.quote: Test the result immediately after the final sampling edge
limitations.note: The agent read a relevant guide on reset-gated combinational output decoding but did not apply its advice to the vending machine.
The agent retried a Python state-space calculation to size the replacement credit and change counters, work that did not diagnose or fix the output timing defect.
